Reconciliation is not a shortcut for passing stand-alone election law. It is designed for taxes, spending, and the debt limit. Because the SAVE America Act is primarily election policy, it does not qualify for reconciliation as written, and the Senate’s Byrd Rule would likely strip out non-budgetary provisions. Anyone claiming the full bill can just be jammed through reconciliation is LYING.

Senate Dems could do the right thing and help pass Voter ID which has overwhelming bipartisan support BUT they would rather fuel division instead of unite for the betterment of our nation. 

Truly sad when you think about it.
